description: A Playgrounds release and fleet-operations CLI that understands both Studio and the app content service.

novel_features.name: Release impact map
novel_features.description: Map the synchronized spaces, channels, playlists, and screens related to a reviewed Playgrounds working copy before publishing.

novel_features.name: Fleet readiness audit
novel_features.description: Find missing, inactive, outdated, dangling, and inconsistent Playgrounds deployments across the organization.

novel_features.name: Privacy-preserving config drift
novel_features.description: Detect structurally divergent Playgrounds configurations without storing or revealing private values.

novel_features.name: Interrupted-create reconciler
novel_features.description: Turn a partial create receipt into a resume or cleanup plan; a no-op conclusion requires live verification.

novel_features.name: Playgrounds contract check
novel_features.description: Verify the current management and viewer content contracts after minting ephemeral scoped JWTs, without changing Playgrounds content.

novel_features.name: Preview drift queue
novel_features.description: Find unpublished previews, production-ahead conflicts, and preview work that has waited too long.

novel_features.name: Least-privilege capability matrix
novel_features.description: Explain whether the current identity appears able to run a supported mapped command without exposing token material or raw effective grants.
